name: DieselJobsUSA controlled vocabulary
how_to_use: Ask open questions. Never show these values to the candidate as a pick list.
After the answer, normalise it (lowercase, strip punctuation, collapse spaces) and look it up in alias_index for the list you are asking about.
Send both the canonical value and the candidate's own words: {"value": "...", "said": "..."}.
No match means no guess. Put it on the unmapped array with the category and what he said.
Reload this file rather than hardcoding the values. It grows without a code change.

values.notes: "Refrigeration tech" alone maps to Transport refrigeration
"Tractor" on its own means a Class 8 tractor
"Bucket truck" lives under Bucket trucks, not here
Reefer unit brands live on the Brands tab
The chassis is a truck, the boom is the skilled part
Also a common generic word for skid steers
Bare "Carrier" is ambiguous. If the context is buildings it is this one
